conclusions: Exact captured-byte hashing and Git attributes/CRLF semantics are preserved.
Fresh scans, verification boundaries, ownership checks, sorted rows and snapshot hashes are preserved.
Batch parsing fails closed on invalid framing, count, type, object ID and ownership.
Worker failures stop queued work and drain active children before rejection.
Benchmark compares identical 648 frozen file rows and inventory hash.

followUp.initialGap: Explicit hash-worker failure/drain regression was missing.
followUp.conclusion: The added controlled-child test proves a four-worker maximum, no queued work after failure, and rejection only after all active children close. A real filename with spaces and brackets also passes.

reviewMethod: Read-only diff and benchmark review; reviewer did not duplicate passed tests or perform live actions.
